simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: Take a practice brief from the tray, check it against the evidence, and brief it back to the Guide.

scoring.notes: Mirrors the in-world quest 'First Brief'. Practice data only.
scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Take one practice brief from the tray and read it end to end.
steps.check: Brief read; the site type and the question it asks both noted.
steps.if_wrong: Read it all. A brief half-read is a brief mis-briefed.

steps.action: Check the brief's figures against the Evidence Layer: every figure needs a source.
steps.check: Each figure matched to a source, or marked unsourced.
steps.if_wrong: An unsourced figure is not evidence. Mark it.

steps.action: Check the assumptions on the forecast board: change one assumption, note what changes.
steps.check: One assumption changed, one consequence noted.
steps.if_wrong: The forecast is only as good as its assumptions. Test one.

steps.action: Brief it back to the Guide in your own words: site, figures, gaps.
steps.check: Brief given; gaps named, not hidden.
steps.if_wrong: A gap hidden is a gap that bites later. Name it.

simulations.title: First Brief — read it, check it, brief it back

simulations.label: SIMULATION — practice only. Not a licence, not a certification, not a credential, not a diagnosis, not advice for any real person, site or deal.
simulations.scenario: A practice deal file arrives with three claims. Source all three — or mark them unsourced.

scoring.pass: All steps in order, every check passed. Practice score only — it certifies nothing.

steps.action: Lay the three claims out on the evidence table, in order.
steps.check: All three claims laid out, none combined.
steps.if_wrong: One claim at a time. Combined claims hide weak ones.

steps.action: For each claim, find its source on the archive shelves.
steps.check: Source found and named, or the claim marked unsourced.
steps.if_wrong: No source, no claim. Mark it and move on.

steps.action: Write the verdict for each claim: sourced, unsourced, or contradicted.
steps.if_wrong: A claim without a verdict is unfinished work.

steps.action: File the review in the tray with the gaps listed on top.
steps.check: Review filed; gaps on top, not buried.
steps.if_wrong: Gaps go on top. Burying a gap fails the run.

Fabric: 38 nodes total (scene root + 22 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'coastal' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (7): Master Dashboard, Underwriting Desk, Evidence Layer, The Academy, Market Editions, Louisiana Developer Desk, Steward Council.

stations.content: Per the 2026-11-05 review (org wiki, not re-verified live 2026-11-07): Locator.X is real-estate development/investment predictive tooling plus a 92-lesson Academy, 85 modules, 50-state guides, with about 4 GB of public-record data referenced but not committed to the repo. The Academy hall here teaches the lesson structure; it contains no real market data, no real site, and no real forecast.
